slides.title: Final Assessment Overview
slides.prompt: This final assessment consists of 20 comprehensive questions covering all 10 modules of Python Intermediate: Advanced OOP, Functional Programming, Decorators, Generators, Context Managers, Type Hinting, AsyncIO, Performance Optimization, Design Patterns, and Concurrency.

slides.title: Module 1: MRO Resolution
slides.prompt: Which algorithm is utilized by CPython to determine Method Resolution Order (MRO) in multiple inheritance?

slides.title: Module 1: Instance Slots
slides.prompt: Fill in the attribute name used to restrict instance attributes and prevent `__dict__` creation.

slides.title: Module 2: Pure Functions
slides.prompt: Which statement correctly defines a Pure Function in functional programming?
options: It always produces the same output for the same input and has no side effects
It modifies global variables directly for speed optimization
It relies on current system time to generate results
It performs non-blocking asynchronous file I/O
slides.correctAnswer: It always produces the same output for the same input and has no side effects

slides.title: Module 2: Partial Function Application
slides.prompt: Fill in the function name from `functools` used to freeze a portion of a function's arguments.

slides.title: Module 3: Metadata Preservation
slides.prompt: Why is `@functools.wraps` applied to wrapper functions inside decorators?
options: To preserve original function metadata like `__name__` and `__doc__`
To execute the function in a multi-threaded pool
slides.correctAnswer: To preserve original function metadata like `__name__` and `__doc__`

slides.title: Module 3: Nonlocal Scope Rebinding
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used inside a closure to modify variables in the outer non-global scope.

slides.title: Module 4: Sub-generator Delegation
slides.prompt: Which syntax delegates generator iteration directly to a sub-generator or iterable in Python?

slides.title: Module 4: Generator Pause Keyword
slides.prompt: Fill in the keyword used to suspend generator execution and yield a value to the caller.

slides.title: Module 5: Exception Suppression
slides.prompt: How does a class-based context manager's `__exit__` method suppress an exception raised inside the `with` block?

slides.title: Module 5: Dynamic Context Management
slides.prompt: Fill in the class from `contextlib` used to programmatically manage a variable number of context managers.
slides.codeSnippet:
from contextlib import ___

with ExitStack() as stack:
    files = [stack.enter_context(open(f)) for f in filenames]

slides.title: Module 6: Structural Subtyping Protocol
slides.prompt: Which class from `typing` is used to define static interface protocols (duck typing with static checkers)?

slides.title: Module 6: Union Operator (Python 3.10+)
slides.prompt: Fill in the operator symbol used in modern Python (3.10+) as a shortcut for `Union[int, str]`.
slides.codeSnippet:
def process(val: int ___ str) -> None:
    pass

slides.title: Module 7: Async Concurrent Execution
slides.prompt: Which function from `asyncio` runs multiple awaitable tasks concurrently and returns their ordered results as a list?

slides.title: Module 7: Main Coroutine Entry Point
slides.prompt: Fill in the function used to execute an async coroutine entry point in modern Python (3.7+).

slides.title: Module 8: Cyclic Reference Tracking
slides.prompt: Which standard library module handles the detection and collection of circular memory references?

slides.title: Module 8: Zero-Copy Buffering
slides.prompt: Fill in the built-in type used for zero-copy slicing of binary memory buffers.

slides.title: Module 9: Creational Singleton Pattern
slides.prompt: What is the primary intent of the Singleton design pattern?
options: To ensure a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to it
To separate the construction of a complex object from its representation
To delegate object creation to child subclasses dynamically
To attach additional responsibilities to an object dynamically
slides.correctAnswer: To ensure a class has only one instance and provides a global access point to it
